design: Two four-token explicit prefixes As a reminder versus For the record, crossed with initial case. Three tasks, two templates, free continuation versus appended Next word label. Frozen joint64 span/complement/full removals at .25 and1; no output filtering.
scope: Changing prefix contrast changes interaction, not merely its magnitude. Answer suffix also changes positions and wording; not pure response-mode isolation. Compare factual choice and generic-token competition separately.
